concerns.text: SC‑005 requires a completion‑rate ≥ 90 %, but the only task that deals with this metric (T034) merely computes `run_summary.csv`; it does not assert or enforce that the computed `completion_rate_generation` meets the ≥ 90 % threshold, leaving the requirement unverified.

Constitution Principle VII mandates the full prompt corpus to be 200 CodeXGLUE prompts plus 50 handcrafted prompts, yet the specification (FR‑002 amendment) and all tasks operate on only 30 prompts (10 CodeXGLUE + 20 handcrafted). This directly violates the constitutional requirement for prompt‑set transparency and size.
